salle_referenced_delete: This room cannot be deleted: sessions or reservations are still attached to it. Please deactivate it instead of deleting.
departement_referenced_delete: This department cannot be deleted: teachers or programmes are still attached. Please reassign them first.
filiere_referenced_delete: This programme cannot be deleted: academic years are still attached. Please delete or reassign them first.
promotion_referenced_delete: This academic year cannot be deleted: data is still attached (enrollments, assignments, fees…). Please handle them first.
annee_referenced_delete: This academic year cannot be deleted: data is still attached (programmes, enrollments, sessions…). Please close it instead of deleting.
annee_dates_incoherentes: The end date of an academic year must be after its start date.
matiere_referenced_delete: This course cannot be deleted: grades have already been recorded for its assessments, or sessions are scheduled on its assignments. Grades and checked sessions are never erased.
affectation_seances_pointees: This assignment cannot be deleted: {nombre} session(s) have an attendance check or a justification, which are proof of service and the basis of payroll. Cancel upcoming sessions instead of deleting the assignment.
affectation_referenced_delete: This assignment cannot be deleted: a session has just been checked. Reload the page and try again.
enseignant_referenced_delete: This teacher cannot be deleted: payroll lines, sessions or justifications are attached to them. Deactivate the record instead.
user_referenced_delete: This account cannot be deleted: it is referenced by recorded checks or other records. Deactivate it instead.
